assignment: Conservative Docker, Kubernetes and Ansible documentation-only guidance for Windows OMP

sources.acquisition: Source-only shallow git clone with core.hooksPath=NUL; revision recorded using git rev-parse HEAD. No source scripts or installers executed.
sources.license_evidence: Repository LICENSE read in full (lines 1-201); identical source file copied into each installed skill using Copy-Item.
sources.notice_inventory: Glob inventory of NOTICE* and LICENSE* found no upstream NOTICE file. Root Apache license applies to selected documentation; unrelated ansible-validator test-role license was not included because none of that role is installed.
sources.selection_reason: Three generator documentation domains are cohesive and nonoverlapping. Useful domain knowledge was rewritten rather than installing automatic validation/setup or Bash generator bundles. No Terraform/Packer skill installed.

installed.name: docker-container-builds
installed.purpose: Dockerfile and dockerignore generation/review, multi-stage builds, runtime/ABI/cache/secret decisions, supplied-evidence diagnosis.
tool_requirements: No external tools required for documentation/manual repository review.
Docker CLI plus explicitly approved compatible engine/builder for actual builds or daemon access.
Buildx/BuildKit features only if already available and supported; no installation implied.
Hadolint or optional scanners only if separately available, requested and permitted; scanner network/download/billing scope requires authorization.
Examples target Linux images from Windows PowerShell; Windows containers need separate base-image/host compatibility design.

installed.name: kubernetes-manifest-operations
installed.purpose: Kubernetes resource generation/review, probes/selectors/resources/RBAC/network/storage semantics, CRD schema limits, approved narrow read-only operations planning.
tool_requirements: No cluster or external tools required for documentation/manual manifest review.
kubectl and an explicitly authorized exact context/namespace for cluster access; credential plugins are a trust prerequisite.
Optional already-installed kubeconform/yamllint; offline schema checks require existing trusted schemas matching Kubernetes and CRD versions.
No local cluster, Helm, Kustomize plugins, CNI, schemas or dependencies installed.
Host commands use PowerShell; Linux Pod security examples must not be applied mechanically to Windows Pods.

installed.name: ansible-automation
installed.purpose: Ansible playbook/role/task/inventory generation and review, module/OS/idempotency/privilege/secret decisions, trusted-controller and exact-target execution planning.
tool_requirements: OMP can edit/review Ansible content on Windows with no Ansible runtime.
Execution requires a separately approved existing supported Linux controller or supported WSL environment, not native Windows PowerShell.
Existing ansible-core, needed collections and optional ansible-lint with suitable versions; no pip/Galaxy installation.
Authorized static/dynamic inventory, reviewed configuration/plugins/roles, SSH or WinRM/PSRP and managed-node prerequisites as applicable.
Windows managed hosts require appropriate modules/collection/transport; Linux controller command examples are explicitly marked shell, not PowerShell.
